critique: The radial heddle-sun feeding gold warp threads into an actively woven, jewel-colored cloth is a strong Afrofuturist conceit, uniting cosmic myth and textile geometry through purposeful motion. The tiny guinea-pig image tucked at the lower edge is an arbitrary distraction, while the cloth’s randomized triangles and checks need a more coherent recurring emblem to feel culturally intentional rather than generically patterned.
